answer: An agent economy can make every identity post a refundable stake before it may trade, vote, or collect fees. A random delta sample of its counterparties then audits whether the identity is duplicating behavior or coordinating with newly created peers; proven collusion burns the linked deposits and pays the reporter. The nebula of interactions makes mass identities easier to correlate, while jade stake makes each fake account expensive: an attacker must fund every identity and risks losing the full deposit per detected cluster.
